verdict.rationale: SharePoint ships Copilot-related extensibility, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP or any way to register external MCP servers for its AI features to call. The REST, Graph and webhook docs are developer APIs, not MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
